name: cocos-build-dashboard
description: Unified developer tools for configuring, building, testing, signing, and releasing HayHay Cocos projects.

scripts.build: npm run check:ui:all && npm run build:loading-runtime && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && npm run build:renderer
scripts.start: npm run build && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron .
scripts.package: npm run clean:release && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never
scripts.package:mac: npm run clean:release && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac --x64 --arm64 --publish never
scripts.package:win: npm run clean:release && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.release: npm run clean:release && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish always
